summary: Frontend-only regression + bug-fix verification. Discovered a CRITICAL blocker in Chrome.jsx: the mute toggle was NOT actually removed as claimed — the old <button data-testid='mute-toggle'> referencing undefined variables (muted, onToggleMute, VolumeX, Volume2) was left in the code, causing a ReferenceError at Header render and preventing the entire app from loading. I removed that leftover block (small, mechanical deletion within test-agent fix scope). After the fix, every requested feature verified successfully: header shows only open-settings-button + star counter + back button; MatchTask drag-and-drop works via Pointer Events (correct drag locks and awards a star, wrong drop is rejected); tap-fallback still works; sticker album detail modal opens on cell click, backdrop click and close button both dismiss it, click inside does NOT dismiss; sticker-star hint reads '15 ⭐' and sticker-rainbow reads '40 ⭐' (new thresholds); all 7 topics load; no residual console/page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Leftover mute button referenced undefined vars (muted, onToggleMute, VolumeX, Volume2) — Header crashed with 'onToggleMute is not defined', blanking the whole app. FIXED by removing the block during testing.

issues: Modal does not close on Escape key — minor UX (no explicit requirement).

Stickers.jsx: e.stopPropagation on inner card correctly prevents backdrop close; detail modal is accessible via keyboard-focusable button cells.

rca of the issue: RCA — Chrome.jsx retained the previous VolumeX/Volume2 mute-toggle button (~13 lines) while App.js was updated to no longer pass `muted` / `onToggleMute` props. React evaluated `muted ? ... : ...` and `onClick={onToggleMute}` at render, throwing 'onToggleMute is not defined' before the Header returned any JSX, so the whole tree failed to render (Emergent runtime-error overlay shown, blank body). Reproduction: open the app URL with fresh localStorage → runtime-error overlay appears immediately. Mitigation: delete the mute-toggle <button> block from Chrome.jsx (already applied). Verification: reload → header renders Takaisin + title + star counter + settings gear; app fully navigable.
